title: DerekArt website
lede: Derek Yaniger’s shop header pairs a bouncing retro logotype with a band of hand-drawn squared spirals in cream, red, and black.
summary: A pink header, a bouncing hand-lettered logo, and a cream, red, and black pattern band with a lowercase slab slogan.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline: the header and pattern band use the style’s bouncing hand lettering and a textile-like repeat confined to one band, but the prints below are loud and clashing, and the page is a shop.

observed: The header is flat dusty pink with a centered logotype, “*DEREKart!”, in red and black letters of mixed sizes that bounce off the baseline, with an asterisk star.
The menu below is dark geometric sans-serif capitals.
A full-width band alternates cream, red, and black blocks with hand-drawn squared spirals in black, red, and gray lines.
At the right end of the band, “can you dig it?” is set in a heavy, rounded lowercase face in cream on red.
Below, on white, “FEATURED PRINTS” heads three poster thumbnails in saturated blue, yellow, magenta, and green with dense cartoon figures.
interpretation: The band shows the rubric’s “pattern as a band” trait directly, and the logotype shows bouncing, mixed lettering.

The featured prints are closer to a psychedelic or tiki revival: saturated, crowded, and outlined. Measured: the CSS sees no chromatic color (the colors are all in images); the screenshot palette finds five hue families.
borrow: Confine a hand-drawn geometric repeat to one horizontal band under the header.
Let a logotype’s letters change size and bounce off the baseline.

images.alt: DerekArt shop home page: a dusty pink header with a bouncing red and black DerekArt logo and a menu, a band of cream, red, and black blocks with hand-drawn squared spirals and the words can you dig it, and three bright poster thumbnails under Featured Prints.
images.caption: First viewport of [derekart.com](https://derekart.com/), 28 September 2026.
